title: l1qw.26b: adopt COSE_Sign1 invitation envelope (alg -65537, bstr-wrapped protected header, kid=inviter IID, invitee_iid check)
description: Child of l1qw.26 (spec 18.8.2): replace the canonical-CBOR string-keyed preimage invitation with COSE_Sign1 per RFC 9052: protected header bstr-wrapped 47A1013A00010000 ({1:-65537}), unprotected kid = inviter 8-byte IID, payload CBOR map with integer keys 1-7, signature over SHA256(CBOR(Sig_structure)) with Schnorr48-Ed25519. Share envelope code with python/src/lichen/crypto/delegation_tokens.py:72-100. Invitee validation: alg check, invitee_iid == own IID. Depends on .26a landing (ledger). Landable with updated groups_membership vectors.
